body:
Bare `CS2R R16, SRZ` writes the implicit 64-bit special-register result across the even/odd 32-bit GPR pair. The SASS lifter previously emitted only the low-half zero write, leaving the upper register stale. This change handles the bare even-GPR `SRZ` pair with two predicate-preserving `mov.u32` writes and raises the declared GPR count to include the implicit upper register. Explicit `.32` retains the existing single-register write; other non-`.32` CS2R forms are diagnosed as unsupported.

Validation: a standalone four-module fixture built offline on CPU 46, passed checks for a bare `CS2R R8, SRZ` whose upper register is otherwise unused (`.reg .b32 %r<10>;` and writes to `%r8/%r9`), and confirmed `.32` remains a single write. NVIDIA CUDA 13.1 `ptxas -arch=sm_120` assembled the generated PTX successfully. No GPU or full LLVM workspace build was run.

In the separately tested QKV v6 candidate, the invalid-memory-access symptom was no longer observed, but the output remained NaN with a separate GEU/BF16 issue. This instruction fixture does not establish whole-kernel correctness.

This PR changes only `ptx/src/sass/lifter.rs`; it contains no HI, FSEL, register-pair helper, output/BF16, or HBF changes.

commits.messageHeadline: Preserve the implicit register pair in CS2R.SRZ

title: Preserve CS2R.SRZ register pair in SASS lifting
